text:
Mina (PM): propose we lock a tiny error contract for next weekmachine code, numeric id, bucket, summary, optional hint. quick feedback?
Omar (Platform): agree. minimal fields: status, code, id, bucket, summary. keep details off the wire or in logs.
Rae (Console): console needs canonical banner text per bucket + severity. will feature-flag mapping so we can preview.
Ben (SDK): SDK helpers: isRetryable(), isAuthError(), severity(). numeric id vital for infra rules.
Lucia (SRE): telemetry: emit bucket, code, id, region. keep meta keys whitelisted to avoid high cardinality. create a replay endpoint for console tests.
Kai (Design): microcopy pattern: 1-line summary + 1 action hint. ex: "Request limit reached" / "Try smaller batches."
Mina (PM): draft buckets: throttling, auth, client_error, infra_transient, not_found, safety_block. each maps to default status but not fixed.
Omar (Platform): suggest code namespace: "retry.gpu_eviction" vs "terminal.model_missing". status is hint only.
Ben (SDK): will accept both legacy text and structured payload for 8 weeks, add lint warnings for parsing messages.
Rae (Console): visual map: throttling->yellow, auth/safety->red, infra_transient->blue, client_error/ not_found->gray.
Lucia (SRE): alerts: set SLO-based thresholds per-bucket; auth spikes = pager. add dashboard panels per-id.
Mina (PM): sample payload:
{
  "error": {
    "status": 429,
    "id": "3021",
    "code": "quota.project_limit",
    "bucket": "throttling",
    "summary": "Request limit reached.",
    "hint": "Reduce parallel requests or request Dedicated capacity.",
    "retry_after": 120
  }
}
Omar (Platform): will add server helper and numeric id registry.
Rae (Console): will wire mapping and preview. schedule UX check with Kai.
Ben (SDK): will prepare releases and compatibility docs.
Lucia (SRE): will add telemetry tags and replay harness.
